v1.2.0.description:
# What's Changed

## New Features
- Checkpoints have been added to each chapter, allowing for load into a partially completed chapter. Checkpoints are unlocked upon reaching the location naturally in the chapter. Additionally, a checkpoint sanity option was added that allows the checkpoints to be randomized into the item pool.
- The tommy gun in chapter 3 can now be optionally included in generation. If it's included, achieving the normal steps to acquire it will only send a check, but won't guarantee the tommy gun can be obtained. Once the "CH3 Tommy Gun" item has been received, the tommy gun will be permanently obtainable, regardless of path choice, ink toy setting, or deaths.
- The lever challenge in chapter 3 can also be included in generation, adding 1 check for each wave of enemies. Loading into checkpoints after the path choice with have the Angel path selected, and the ink toy on Boris.
- Goal chapter can now be set as any chapter. Any chapter after the goal chapter will be excluded from randomization unless the Include Later Chapters option is enabled. If a chosen starting chapter would be discluded from from randomization, the starting chapter will default to chapter 1

## QoL
- The number of obtained and required Bacon Soups is now visible in the top left corner of the screen, below connection info
- Connect button has been moved back to the menu in the top left in case connection is lost while in game
- Renamed and added additional filler items

## Bugfixes
- fixed theMeatly locations not being present in the Client ID table
